text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, looking into the library,
I saw Wonder Acute seemingly writing a letter.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
With warm feelings and deep respect...
“Wonder Acute”—and done. That'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just writing a little reply to a fan letter.
Hehe, it actually came all the way from overseas, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "Apparently when they came to Japan, they happened to catch a race I ran in."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ‘Her tenacity in facing challenges gave me courage...’

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I will work hard every day with the goal of
watching races in Japan again someday—"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It's really amazing, isn't it? My running actually reached people all the way across the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, all I could do was cheer on
the gym trainees from outside the ring.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yet after coming to Tracen Academy
and doing so much training with you, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Just by giving every race my all, without even realizing it, I was able to encourage someone out there...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"What made me happier than anything else was that
this person made seeing me one more time their goal."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I ran wanting to support someone who was trying their best, but...
I never thought it could reach people like this."
choice_data_list: We'll have to keep running longer and more often.
We'll have to keep running longer and more often.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Even if I came all the way to Japan, it'd be completely ruined if I'm not running in top shape!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A journey of a thousand miles
begins with a single step.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We each need to take that thousand-mile journey one step at a time,
so we can meet again with smiles on our faces.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, Trainer!
Let's keep working hard and steady today too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From that day on, Wonder Acute began dedicating herself even more earnestly to her training.
